item.title: IRGC's 'larger than normal' presence poses challenge in search for missing F-15E crew member, expert warns
item.summary: Military expert says U.S. search and rescue for a missing F-15E crew member in Iran is complicated by a large IRGC presence in the crash region.

item.title: Cruise line abruptly adds extra charges for passengers as travelers worry others may follow
item.summary: Cruise passengers fear retroactive charges as oil prices surge 40% since the Iran conflict, with cruise lines' fine print allowing added fees. Ticket prices could rise too.

item.title: Knicks broadcaster's joke comparing Bulls' 'obliterated' defense to Iran leaves partner stunned
item.summary: Walt 'Clyde' Frazier remarked that friends thought he was talking about Iran when describing the Chicago Bulls' defense, prompting a stunned reaction from Mike Breen.

item.title: UK prosecutors charge 3, including dual Pakistani citizen, in arson attack on Jewish ambulances in London
item.summary: Three suspects are charged in a disturbing arson attack targeting Jewish community ambulances in north London, an act UK PM Starmer called antisemitic.

item.title: ICE arrests relatives of slain Iranian general Soleimani living in US after Rubio revokes their green cards
item.summary: Relatives of slain Iranian Maj. Gen. Qasem Soleimani were arrested by ICE after Secretary of State Rubio revoked their U.S. legal status, officials said.

item.title: Georgetown University to offer pornography course to students
item.summary: Georgetown University will offer a pornography course this fall examining pornography production and "the pornographic" in contemporary media, culture, and social conflicts.

item.title: Trump unveils $1.5T defense surge, deep domestic cuts — what’s on the budget chopping block
item.summary: The White House proposes a fiscal year 2027 budget with roughly $1.5 trillion in defense spending and sweeping cuts to key domestic programs.

item.title: Study reveals one simple eating habit that may help boost weight-loss
item.summary: People who ate repeat meals lost more weight during a 12-week program, a new study found. Experts say routine eating can reduce decision fatigue as long as it's nutritionally balanced.

item.title: Niki Taylor chooses Nashville 'privacy' after ‘90s supermodel fame
item.summary: 90s supermodel Niki Taylor said she now prefers privacy and family in Nashville after years of nonstop international runways in her early career.

item.title: Charlize Theron stuns in yellow bikini during Hawaiian beach vacation with her two daughters
item.summary: Charlize Theron stuns in a yellow bikini during a Hawaiian vacation with her daughters, after sharing her views on aging and embracing single motherhood.
